title: Pro Tip: Inspecting Drain Venting
description: When troubleshooting slow-draining fixtures, professionals always look beyond the immediate trap and check the drainage venting system. Proper air intake is essential for maintaining neutral atmospheric pressure inside the piping network, allowing wastewater to flow smoothly without siphoning fixture traps. A blocked or improperly sized vent can cause gurgling sounds, slow drainage, or sewer gas odors entering the living space. By understanding how drainage and venting work together as a complete system, technicians can accurately diagnose root causes rather than just treating recurring symptoms.
